# Contract: `dist/web/tokens.css` Structure & Ordering

What `packages/tokens/src/generate.ts` MUST emit. **Supersedes the `tokens —
web output` section of `specs/001-core-packages-scaffold/contracts/token-output.md`**
(that doc described the flat scaffold shape; a pointer note is added there during
the task phase). The `index.js` / `index.d.ts` / iOS Swift outputs from the 001
contract are unchanged except that Swift identifiers are now sanitised (D7).

## File shape

```css
/* Generated by @design-system/tokens. Do not edit. */
:root {
  --ds-color-bg: #ffffff;
  --ds-space-md: 1rem;
  --ds-type-body: normal normal 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  --ds-color-bg: #111111;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  :root {
    --ds-space-md: 1.5rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  [data-theme="dark"] .ds-scope-compact {
    --ds-space-md: 1.25rem;
  }
}

.ds-scope-compact {
  --ds-space-md: 0.75rem;
}
```

## Rules

1. **Header** — first line is exactly
   `/* Generated by @design-system/tokens. Do not edit. */`.
2. **One custom property per token per matching condition.** Name is
   `--ds-<category>-<key>` (kebab-cased). Value is emitted verbatim (no
   normalisation) — including full `font` shorthand strings with commas. Colour
   values are already-resolved literals; **no `--ds-palette-*` property is ever
   emitted** (FR-015, SC-007, research D11).
3. **Block order = ResolvedRule order** (data-model D3/D9), ascending specificity,
   so the last matching declaration in the cascade is the most specific. Within
   that order, consecutive rules with an **identical wrapper** are merged into one
   block. A test asserts the emitted selectors' CSS specificity is non-decreasing
   down the file, so source-order tie-breaking always resolves to the most
   specific match (research D13, analyze finding G1).
4. **Wrappers by condition-set**:

   | Condition-set | Wrapper |
   |---------------|---------|
   | `{}` | `:root { … }` — value is `overrides.light ?? value` |
   | `{colorMode: "dark"}` | `[data-theme="dark"] { … }` |
   | `{minWidth: n}` | `@media (min-width: npx) { :root { … } }` |
   | `{scope: s}` | `.ds-scope-<s> { … }` |
   | `{colorMode, minWidth}` | `@media (min-width: npx) { [data-theme="dark"] { … } }` |
   | `{colorMode, scope}` | `[data-theme="dark"] .ds-scope-<s> { … }` |
   | `{minWidth, scope}` | `@media (min-width: npx) { .ds-scope-<s> { … } }` |
   | `{colorMode, minWidth, scope}` | `@media (min-width: npx) { [data-theme="dark"] .ds-scope-<s> { … } }` |

   `colorMode: "light"` never produces its own block — it folds into `:root`
   (base) or, combined with other axes, simply omits the `[data-theme]` part
   (light is the default surface).
5. **Determinism** — identical source ⇒ byte-identical file, including when
   overrides are authored in a different nesting order (FR-010, SC-003).
6. **Empty** — no tokens ⇒ the file is the header plus `:root {}` (FR-011).
7. **No CSS Modules, no component/class styles beyond `.ds-scope-*` token
   blocks, no hardcoded literals other than the token values themselves**
   (Constitution I; spec Clarifications).

## Cascade behaviour the ordering guarantees

For a token with base + `{dark}` + `{dark, scope: compact}` overrides, with both
`data-theme="dark"` and `.ds-scope-compact` active:

| Active conditions | Winning declaration | Value |
|-------------------|--------------------|-------|
| none | `:root` | base |
| dark only | `[data-theme="dark"]` | dark value |
| dark + compact | `[data-theme="dark"] .ds-scope-compact` (emitted later, specificity 5) | combined value |
| compact only (light) | `.ds-scope-compact` | scope value (if authored) else base |

## Known limitation (D4)

The `{colorMode, scope}` wrapper uses a **descendant** combinator
(`[data-theme="dark"] .ds-scope-compact`). A scope class on the *same* element
carrying `data-theme` is not matched. Consumers put `data-theme` on/above
`<html>` and scope classes on wrapper elements. A compound-selector variant is a
possible later feature; out of scope here.
